comments.author: Zodaxa
comments.body_html:
My friends told me long ago that they made all the traders furrys, here I am jumping into SPT and all it offers and behold here you are. Wah wah ai art generic complai- ITS GOOD THO? And you dropped source with everything to basically recreate the images. Good enough for me, normalize that!

This mod has also introduced me to some traders I’ve really started to enjoy, that I wouldn’t have otherwise. Grabbed em as a “Might as well, more creatures!”. Guiding Light and Artem big ones that I hesitated on, mostly o7 questing bots (can’t GL) and general OP nature that artem could be on paper but it’s been great.

Now… Have I gone overboard and the amount of traders don’t fit on the screen? Yeah… But if they could all be dogs well it’d be worth. Requests and Recommendations are below

Scholars Society from Skills Extended Librarian of course, maybe a flamingo? Or an Ant-Eater, with the funny glasses at the tip of the nose? This trader is nearly exclusively there to sell you lockpicks after that quest line… unless catburgler sells them off-rip (crazy). But the quests are simple/fun and the lockpicking is op/yet skill checked. Priscilu from TimmyGG Edition, And the other versions I like my traders, and I like them with quests. Could just c/p the Priscilu origins image for all of them. As it’s the same sloth after all. Requisitions Office from Raid Overhaul You only interact with this trader after bringing the head of a custom boss (by default). And they initially give you quests to craft custom prison wallets. With how hardcore the boss, the items, the trades, the energy. I easily imagine a grizzled, war-torn, craftsmen of a rottweiler dog, cigar and all. Hideout Harry from … HarryHideout Honestly I use them as a lookup table to search the item on the flee to see if I can get it cheaper anywhere as playing with softcore, barter only economy is fun. Anyways I imagine an old tortoise who’s got everything you ever need. Big grandma oogway vibes

Yeah did I just now make an account to comment this? Yeah, it’s been a good time… and my chat wont stop acting up for therapist and puppor
